reason: T0032 delivered the two things that matter: (1) export_design SUCCESS — all four HLS IPs are now packaged as IP-XACT with the real Xilinx Divider LogiCORE bundled, which is the hard prerequisite for any future IP-Integrator flow; (2) five real Vivado OOC component synths, summed to an authoritative [HW-EST] integrated resource total that SUPERSEDES the T0031 HLS-estimate projection. The read_checkpoint -cell link failure is a Vivado 2024.1 tooling quirk on this host, not a design defect — and the integrated single-netlist co-synth was already deferred_to_camera_ready in the T0031 ACK. The refined real-synth numbers (169 DSP / 8.6%, 76028 LUT / 8.5%, 236.5 BRAM tiles / 24.5%, 35 URAM / 7.6%) pass every resource axis with wide margin and are accepted as the Table V [HW-EST] system total. The HLS-vs-Vivado deltas (INT8 mults map to far fewer DSPs; HLS under-counted vit_encoder BRAM) are exactly why the Vivado number is authoritative.
